text:
Leah: Ran the daily billing diff and noticed a $16.2k GPU charge from ap-southeast1 tagged to 'trial-customer-A' but the trial should have caps. Suspect quota enforcement failed and jobs spilled to paid pool. cc @Victor @Sam

billing-bot: Alert: high GPU spend detected for project trial-customer-A. Delta +$16,243 over 36h. Export: https://billing.internal/exports/1887654321-trial-apac.csv

Victor: Ouch. Do we have the sandbox quota logs? If enforcement didn't kick, vendor might not credit. Also need to see which customers actually ran jobs vs automated tests.

Sam: Quick check - looks like the test harness used a service account that bypassed the quota check after a deploy on 2026-03-10. I have the deploy id and will pull instance list.

Rina: For accounting, options: 1) charge Customer A (not ideal), 2) allocate to Platform as incident (our bug), or 3) split with Sales if this was a demo. What do reviewers think?

Leah: Given it's our enforcement bug, recommend Platform absorbs 80% and Sales take 20% (demos/customer goodwill). Need Finance approval for GL move.

Victor: Agreed. I'll draft the vendor case too in case Google issues a retro-credit, but we shouldn't assume we get it. Also please backfill tags so dashboards stop reporting untagged spikes. SQL I plan to run (dry run first):
```
SELECT instance_id, meter_id, ts, cost FROM billing.gpu_usage
WHERE project='trial-customer-A' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-09' AND '2026-03-11' AND label IS NULL;
```

Sam: Will run dry-run and share CSV of instance_ids. Also flag the deploy id (deploy-20260310-89) for eng oncall.

Rina: Finance approves provisional allocation: Platform 80% -> GL PLAT-INCIDENT-2026, Sales 20% -> GL SALES-DEMOS-2026. Please attach FIN-REQ: FIN-2026-0481 and record memo: "trial enforcement failure; provisional allocation pending vendor credit."

billing-bot: Ticket created: Case 555777 with Cloud Billing Support. ETA 3-7 business days. Attachments: instance CSV pending.

Leah: I'll proceed with the backfill dry-run tonight, then apply after sign-off. Leaving thread open until case resolves and ledger shows FIN-2026-0481 posted.
